set.body:
Problem
The rsync wrapper uses sync.DEFAULT_SSH instead of the active SSHTransport configuration. Configured ControlPath and extra SSH options (for example port or ProxyJump) are omitted. Therefore rsync-backed put/get can use a different connection or endpoint from the already-authenticated remoteslurm stub.

Verified at 7d3f775d4846440889ba9162f6a4eb6ac0fadae7 on 2026-09-26 against the installed editable CLI.
Sources:
- src/remoteslurm/cli.py:649-673, _rsync(), uses sync.DEFAULT_SSH.
- src/remoteslurm/transport.py:96-106, _host_ssh_opts() and _ssh_base(), include control_path and extra_ssh_opts.
Both cmd_put() and cmd_get() use this rsync path.

Reproduction (no remote side effects)
```python
import argparse
import subprocess
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
import remoteslurm.cli as cli
import remoteslurm.sync as sync
from remoteslurm.transport import SSHTransport

cluster = MagicMock()
cluster.transport = SSHTransport(
    alias="fixture-host",
    control_path="/tmp/fixture-socket",
    extra_ssh_opts=["-p", "2222"],
)
with patch.object(sync, "find_rsync", return_value=("rsync", "3.5")), \
     patch.object(sync, "expand_remote", return_value="/remote/target"), \
     patch.object(cli.subprocess, "run",
                  return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0)) as run:
    cli._rsync(cluster, "source/", "/remote/target",
               to_remote=True, args=argparse.Namespace(json=True))
    argv = run.call_args.args[0]
    ssh_command = argv[argv.index("-e") + 1]
    print(ssh_command)
    assert "fixture-socket" in ssh_command and "2222" in ssh_command
```

Observed SSH command:
ssh -o ControlMaster=no -o BatchMode=yes -o LogLevel=ERROR

The assertion fails: ControlPath and port are absent, although both appear in cluster.transport._ssh_base().

Live relevance
Nibi doctor reported an explicit remoteslurm ControlPath distinct from the default SSH-config path. For neuroatlas qualification preparation, non-deleting rsync with that explicit live socket and the intended source slash succeeded (initial upload 6.9 seconds). This was a workaround; the defective rsync path was not deliberately exercised against Nibi to provoke MFA.

Acceptance
- Derive the rsync SSH command from the active SSHTransport, sharing transport option construction rather than copying another fixed command.
- Quote argv correctly for rsync -e, including socket paths and option values with spaces.
- Tests cover both put/get directions, explicit ControlPath, port/ProxyJump via extra_ssh_opts, and the default-config case.
- Preserve OpenSSH first-value precedence and the same authenticated socket identity used by stub/control operations.
- Keep batch mode and finite connection timeouts; do not initiate a fresh interactive MFA login as an automatic fallback.
- Verify the fix with an existing authenticated transport and retain explicit endpoint/hash evidence for any live transfer.

Evidence
/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/neuroatlas/data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/remoteslurm-findings.md
/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/neuroatlas/data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/work/remoteslurm-bug-reproduction.json
/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/neuroatlas/data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/work/nibi-upload.log.meta.json

Boundary: neither this defect nor the trailing-slash defect establishes the cause of the earlier Trillium squeue/sshare/sbatch timeouts, which used the stub path. No fix has been applied.
set.title: Preserve active SSH transport options in rsync put/get
